shots.title: HOOK – Aftermath of the slap
shots.direction: Extreme close-up: only Nila’s eyes and hands; trembling hand against tear-wet cheek, other fist holding crumpled old rupee notes. Dim palm-leaf hut doorway, hurricane lantern and tin trunk. Blue shadows, warm amber rim.

shots.title: HOOK – Father kisses her palms
shots.direction: Close-up: remorseful father gently kisses daughter’s small palms held in his large hands, tears on his face; Nila’s surprised eyes softly blurred above. Matchboxes on floor, distant workers in low tiled shed, smoky bare-bulb light. Wholesome family affection.

shots.title: Collapsed hut in rain (recap)
shots.direction: Wide establishing shot: collapsed mud-and-thatch hut in dusk rain, broken cot, overturned clay pot, neem tree, distant lantern glow. No people or silhouettes. Indigo and cool moonlight.

shots.title: Pechi Paati offers shelter
shots.direction: Medium eye-level: Paati raises a hurricane lantern and beckons from high wooden threshold of tiled house, fresh kolam, raised thinnai, jute cot inside. Warm amber against cool indigo rain.

shots.title: Nila begins narrating
shots.direction: Close-up: Nila looks toward viewer with gently sad eyes and faint smile, inside Paati’s house, jute cot and lantern on low wooden stool, lime-washed wall. Soft amber and blue shadows.

shots.title: Parents rebuilding
shots.direction: Medium wide in hot daylight: parents carry baskets of stones and sand on heads toward half-built mud wall, sweating; bullock-cart wheel and palm-leaf bundles. Harsh gold sunlight, deep blue shadows. Daylight action overrides conflicting night setting phrase.

shots.title: Roof being thatched
shots.direction: High angle: parents tie palm-leaf thatch to wooden roof frame with coconut rope, sun on backs, half-built mud walls, leaf bundles and clay water pot. Dusty gold and cool shadow.

shots.title: Mud-stained hands
shots.direction: Extreme close-up: mother’s cracked mud-stained hands and red glass bangles press wet mud and stones into wall; sweat at wrist. Earthy tones and gold rim.

shots.title: Nila, Maha and Saran play

shots.title: Maha invites Nila inside

Tiled house, lime-washed walls, raised thinnai, high wooden threshold, fresh kolam, hanging hurricane lantern and jute cot. Golden glow. Use established Maha sky-blue blouse/coral skirt/blue ribbons, not conflicting green-frock draft.

shots.title: Looking into the house

shots.title: Nila’s fearful face

shots.title: Palm on the cool floor

shots.title: Proud little smile
